title: upToId: non-string value silently ignored instead of invalidArguments
description: In handle_email_query_changes and handle_mailbox_query_changes, upToId parsing: Some(_) => None silently ignores non-string/non-null values. If client sends 'upToId': 42 (a number), the handler proceeds with upToId=None. Client intends the query to stop at a specific ID but the server ignores the constraint and returns more results. RFC 8620 §5.6: upToId is Id|null; a non-string is invalid and should return invalidArguments.
